Updated: 2026-11-11 · Measured Xu v0.12.2 · Dual-Architecture (ARM64 + x86_64)

Multi-Architecture Cross-Language Benchmarks

Rigorous, reproducible cross-language benchmarks comparing Xu v0.12.2 against C (best Clang O1–O3), Rust (best rustc O1–O3), Swift (swiftc -O), and Go (go build) across 60 groups and 72 measured workload variants. Concurrently verified across dual architectures (ARM64 & x86_64) on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

Expand related workloads to compare their separate algorithms and input sizes. Results are never pooled.

Openness & Transparency Charter

Unbiased, 100% Transparent Cross-Language Benchmarks

Every benchmark runs fully automated inside GitHub Actions cloud runners across physical and isolated OS environments. Test implementations, compilation flags, execution environments, and raw metrics are 100% open-source and publicly auditable. We eliminate cherry-picked data, artificial optimizations, and black-box measurements.

Automated CI: GitHub Actions Compiler Bootstrap Verified: Gen2 = Gen3 Source Actions Run (fa61bf1f284f8257b28526a1ff4078ef7264533f) github.com/xulang-org/bench Raw Dataset: benchmarks.json

100% Open-Source Implementations

Implementations for all 72 workloads are publicly accessible, with Xu, C, Rust, Go, and Swift references where available. Inspect algorithm structure with the in-page 'View Source' modal or browse on GitHub.

Strict Isomorphic Workloads & No Bias

Workloads strictly share equivalent algorithmic logic and data structures. No hand-tuned assembly hacks or specialized compiler cheating. C and Rust automatically select the lowest measured median among O1–O3.

Automated Dual-Arch 6-Platform CI

Concurrently measured across macOS, Linux, and Windows on both ARM64 and x86_64 architectures. Every data point is generated in cloud runners without manual local machine selection.

7-Run Median & Open Dataset

Seven independent whole-program executions per implementation; wall time uses the median, accounting for cold launch overhead. Peak RSS and unstripped binary size are reported faithfully with full JSON datasets.

Benchmark Methodology & Execution Environment

Seven whole-program executions per implementation; reported wall time is the median including process launch. The rankings use default Xu optimization. C and Rust select the lowest measured median among O1/O2/O3. Linux peak RSS is collected in a separate post-exec run; tracing is excluded from wall time. macOS uses wait4 and Windows uses peak working set; these OS accounting methods differ. Only successful, output-verified runs carry metrics. Failures retain their status and diagnostics. Compiler identities and source closures were verified. Bootstrap fixed point: Gen3 = Gen4.

Compiler Toolchains & Optimization Flags
Language / ToolchainBuild FlagsRuntime & Memory Model
Xuxu build (versioned defaults)Zero GC / RAII Scope Drop / Native machine-code backend

Rust (rustc)rustc -C opt-level=1 / 2 / 3 (lowest median)Zero GC / Ownership Drop / LLVM Backend

Replace both /path/to paths: XU_ROOT is the Xu source checkout at fa61bf1f284f8257b28526a1ff4078ef7264533f; --xu is the matching published SDK executable (xu.exe on Windows).

$ git clone https://github.com/xulang-org/bench.git && cd bench && git checkout 6cf469d256cc77ac66448fb48a4abd153e17f3ab && XU_ROOT=/path/to/xu-source-0.12.2 python3 scripts/bench_crosslang.py --xu /path/to/xu-sdk-0.12.2/bin/xu --iters 7 --out reports/crosslang.txt
